summary: Vertical comparison lifestyle poster. Upper main scene shows the C1Splus-style black electric cargo scooter on a sunny seaside boardwalk, oriented with rear wheel on the left and front wheel on the right. A woman rides the scooter, and a tan-and-white dog sits inside the central cargo enclosure. Large marketing headline and comparison labels are present. Lower section is a black-and-white comparison scene with another woman walking a dog on a leash. A wide white diagonal divider separates the two scenes.
